s: Gabriel announces the births of John the Baptist and of Jesus. Mary visits Elizabeth and sings the Magnificat. Zechariah's song of praise.
Jesus is born in Bethlehem and laid in a manger, and angels announce it to shepherds. He is presented in the temple and found there at twelve.
John the Baptist preaches, and Jesus is baptized. Jesus' family tree back to Adam.
Jesus is tempted in the desert. He reads from Isaiah in the synagogue at Nazareth and is rejected, then heals many.
The miraculous catch of fish and the call of Peter. Jesus heals a leper and a paralysed man and calls Levi.
Jesus chooses the twelve. The Sermon on the Plain: blessed are the poor; love your enemies; be merciful.
Jesus heals a centurion's servant and raises a widow's son at Nain. A sinful woman anoints his feet and is forgiven.
The parable of the sower. Jesus calms the storm, frees a possessed man, heals a woman and raises Jairus's daughter.
Jesus sends out the twelve, feeds five thousand, and is confessed by Peter as the Christ. The Transfiguration. He sets his face toward Jerusalem.
Jesus sends out seventy-two disciples. The parable of the Good Samaritan. Martha and Mary.
Jesus teaches the Our Father: ask, seek, knock. He rebukes the Pharisees and lawyers.
Beware of hypocrisy and greed: the rich fool. Do not be anxious. Be ready like servants waiting for their master.
Repent or perish. Jesus heals a bent woman on the sabbath. Strive to enter by the narrow door.
Jesus heals on the sabbath. Take the lowest place. The parable of the great banquet. The cost of being a disciple.
Parables of mercy: the lost sheep, the lost coin and the prodigal son.
The dishonest steward. The rich man and Lazarus.
Forgiveness and faith like a mustard seed. Ten lepers are healed, but only one returns to give thanks. The kingdom of God is among you.
The persistent widow, the Pharisee and the tax collector. Jesus blesses children, meets a rich ruler and heals a blind man.
Zacchaeus welcomes Jesus. The parable of the pounds. Jesus enters Jerusalem and weeps over it, and cleanses the temple.
Jesus' authority is questioned. The wicked tenants, the tribute to Caesar and the resurrection.
The widow's two coins. Jesus foretells the destruction of Jerusalem and his return.
The Last Supper: this is my body; do this in memory of me. The agony on the Mount of Olives, the arrest and Peter's denial.
Jesus is tried before Pilate and Herod and crucified. He forgives his executioners and promises paradise to the repentant thief.
The empty tomb. The risen Jesus walks with two disciples to Emmaus and is known in the breaking of the bread. He appears to the apostles and ascends.

1: The angel Gabriel asks Mary to be the mother of God's Son. Her yes, be it done to me according to your word, is the moment God becomes man.
Mary praises God who lifts up the lowly. The Church sings her song every evening.
2: The Son of God is born in poverty in Bethlehem, and the good news is first told to shepherds.
15: The father runs to welcome his returning son. Jesus shows how God receives every sinner who comes home.
22: Jesus gives himself in the bread and wine and tells the apostles: do this in memory of me.
23: On the cross Jesus promises paradise to a criminal who turns to him in faith.
24: Two disciples recognize the risen Jesus in the breaking of the bread, as at every Mass.
